concept: Use two forward Barracks for early Reaper harassment, then establish a forward Command Center that becomes a Planetary Fortress while transitioning into Reaper-Cyclone pressure.
rules: Check emergency_defence first, then forward_fortress. Otherwise use opening, proxy_barracks, reaper_pressure, forward_fortress, cyclone_transition.
Keep two workers on the proxy only until the two forward Barracks are complete; preserve the designated Command Center builder afterward.
Use Reapers for harassment and scouting, not losing fights against static defence. Add Cyclones when the army and resources are sufficient.
The forward Command Center is an aggressive anchor, not a reason to abandon SCVs, Supply Depots, and safe production at home.

enter_when: The first two forward Barracks are not yet under construction.
guidance: Train two early SCVs, build a Supply Depot, and send both workers to a forward proxy location.
Keep the opening light on optional technology.

enter_when: Forward Barracks are under construction or only one is ready.
phases.goal: Complete the Reaper production anchor and protect it.
guidance: Complete two forward Barracks and start Reapers from every ready Barracks.
Use the first Reapers to protect builders and harass without committing into static defence.

enter_when: The forward Command Center is not yet complete near the enemy.
phases.goal: Use mobility to buy time and space for the forward Command Center.
guidance: Harass workers and weak production while keeping Reapers able to escape.
Send one SCV to an enemy-side expansion location and start a Command Center when resources allow.
Use Reapers to deny enemy workers and vulnerable units around the construction site.

enter_when: A forward Command Center is under construction or complete near the enemy side.
It is not yet a finished Planetary Fortress.
phases.goal: Turn the forward Command Center into a durable pressure point.
guidance: Protect the Command Center with Reapers and supporting units.
If it must fly, move it to the intended location and land safely; upgrade it to a Planetary Fortress when resources permit.

enter_when: The forward fortress is established, the game is past the early timing, or resources support Cyclones.
phases.goal: Sustain pressure with Reaper-Cyclone while growing the economy.
guidance: Transition toward Cyclones as the main fighting unit and Reapers as mobile harassment.
Expand when the army is large enough or resources are high, and add Engineering Bay upgrades after a second base.
Keep the forward Planetary Fortress useful but retreat from unfavorable fights.

enter_when: Enemy forces directly threaten the main base, workers, or essential production.
phases.goal: Preserve the main economy over an unsalvageable forward position.
guidance: Defend first with nearby Reapers, Cyclones, and necessary SCVs.
If the forward Command Center cannot be saved safely, treat it as expendable and resume from the stable home economy.
